focal_blueprints.track_name_zh: AI/CS 小论文：Related Work 批判分类与 Methodology 机制阐述（BP09–BP16）
focal_blueprints.title_zh: 生成模型专属：条件控制与采样去噪轨迹阐述段（Generative Modeling Mechanism）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想阐述生成模型（Diffusion / Flow Matching / Autoregressive）如何在满足外部物理约束或条件观测的前提下，生成高质量且多样化的序列/轨迹。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: 生成模型 / 时序生成 / 轨迹生成论文 Methodology 章节
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [无条件/朴素引导缺陷 Naive Guidance Bottleneck]：Applying post-hoc classifier guidance to pre-trained diffusion samplers often pushes intermediate noisy states off the data manifold, inducing high-frequency artifacts.
S2 [本文流形内条件注入机制 Manifold-Consistent Conditioning]：To enforce hard boundary constraints without manifold deviation, we embed [Condition/Constraint] directly into the velocity field / denoising kernel.

S3 [具体轨迹更新方程 Trajectory Update Formulation]：At solver step $\tau \in [0, 1]$, the conditional velocity field $v_\theta(x_\tau, \tau \mid c)$ projects the unconstrained flow onto the tangent space of feasible trajectories.
S4 [采样效率与分布保真收益 Sampling & Fidelity Guarantee]：This tangent projection guarantees exact boundary satisfaction at $\tau=1$ while permitting straight 4-step Euler integration.
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Guidance Artifact Problem -> Intrinsic Velocity Conditioning -> Tangent Projection Step -> Fast Exact Convergence. 绑定逻辑规则：L026, L014.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: Normal diffusion guidance makes the generated time series look unnatural when we add constraints. So we put the constraint inside the flow matching model, and it generates realistic samples in only 4 steps.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 缺乏生成模型核心术语（data manifold, velocity field, tangent projection, Euler integration），解释过于口语化。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: Applying post-hoc gradient guidance during diffusion sampling often pushes intermediate noisy states off the data manifold, introducing unphysical high-frequency oscillations. To enforce physical boundary constraints without manifold deviation, we incorporate observation consistency directly into the conditional flow-matching velocity field. At flow time $\tau \in [0, 1]$, our network predicts a residual velocity $v_\theta(x_\tau, \tau \mid c)$ that projects the transport trajectory onto the null space of the linear constraint operator. This projection guarantees exact boundary satisfaction at terminal time $\tau=1$ while maintaining straight transport paths amenable to 4-step Euler integration.

focal_blueprints.track_name_zh: 小作文与图表/数据综合写作：IELTS Task 1 / TOEFL Integrated / 科研趋势报告（BP25–BP32）
focal_blueprints.title_zh: 静态多组数据横向对比与倍差/占比凸显段（Cross-Group Proportions）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想写静态柱状图或饼图的主体段：横向对比不同国家/不同模型在不同开销维度上的占比差异，灵活运用倍数（double/triple）、分数（nearly a third）与排序结构。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: IELTS Task 1 静态图表段 / 论文开销拆解（Breakdown）段
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [主导项锁定 Dominant Category]：Regarding [Group 1], [Category A] claims the largest share at [46%], nearly double the proportion allocated to [Category B] ([24%]).
S2 [组间横向反差 Cross-Group Contrast]：A markedly different allocation pattern emerges in [Group 2], where [Category C] dominates at [52%], while [Category A] shrinks to just [15%].
S3 [次要项合并归纳 Minor Categories Grouping]：Meanwhile, the remaining categories—[Category D and E]—collectively account for less than [12%] across both groups.
S4 [结构性差异提炼 Structural Takeaway]：These figures indicate that whereas [Group 1] prioritizes [Function A], [Group 2] concentrates resources heavily on [Function C].
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Dominant Item with Multiplier -> Sharp Cross-Group Contrast -> Pooled Minor Items -> Structural Synthesis. 绑定逻辑规则：L009, L010.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: In Group 1, A is 46%, B is 24%, C is 18%, D is 7%, and E is 5%. In Group 2, C is 52%, B is 22%, A is 15%, D is 6%, and E is 5%.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 把文字写成了 CSV 表格转储，完全没有归并次要项，也没有提炼倍差与结构反差。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: Within edge-device inference workloads, attention matrix computation consumes the largest fraction of total energy at 48%, exactly double the power drawn by feed-forward layers (24%). A strikingly different profile emerges in onboard robotic control loops, where high-frequency sensor preprocessing dominates energy usage at 51%, while attention overhead contracts to just 16%. Across both deployment settings, memory offloading and actuation decoding collectively account for under 11% of total consumption. This contrast highlights that optimization bottlenecks shift from quadratic token mixing on cloud servers to raw sensory I/O on physical robots.

focal_blueprints.track_name_zh: 六级（CET-6）/ 雅思大作文（Task 2）/ 托福独立写作：深度论证与让步反驳（BP33–BP40）
focal_blueprints.title_zh: 议论文收尾段：跳出简单重复，完成核心权衡整合与边界升华（Synthesis Conclusion）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想写六级、雅思 Task 2 或托福独立写作的结尾段（Conclusion）：用 2–3 句话收束全文，做到既呼应中心论点、整合正反权衡，又绝不喊假大空口号（Let us work together for a better tomorrow）。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: CET-6 / IELTS Task 2 / TOEFL 结尾段
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [重申核心权衡与立场 Restate Nuanced Thesis]：In conclusion, while [Acknowledged Factor A] introduces real challenges in [Specific Aspect], [Core Thesis Stance] remains the most viable path forward.
S2 [整合全文两大支柱机制 Synthesize Dual Pillars]：By combining [Pillar 1 from Body 1] with [Pillar 2 / Safeguard from Body 2], [Actors] can harness [Core Benefit] while containing [Primary Risk].
S3 [理性边界展望（可选）Grounded Forward Look]：Ultimately, the success of [Technology/Policy] depends not on its standalone capability, but on the institutional rigor with which it is governed.
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Balanced Restatment -> Dual-Pillar Synthesis -> Grounded Governance Principle (Zero Slogans!). 绑定逻辑规则：L023, L029.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: In conclusion, AI has both advantages and disadvantages. We should make full use of its advantages and avoid its disadvantages. Let us work hand in hand to welcome a bright future of AI!
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 结尾段最忌讳的三句废话全中：既有好处也有坏处 + 扬长避短 + 让我们携手共创美好未来（口号感叹句）。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: In conclusion, while automated decision systems inevitably introduce transitional labor friction and verification challenges, integrating them into industrial and academic workflows yields substantial long-term productivity gains. By pairing algorithmic deployment with transparent audit trails and targeted workforce retraining, institutions can capture efficiency breakthroughs without eroding human analytical oversight. Ultimately, the value of intelligent automation rests not on replacing human judgment, but on elevating the precision of the evidence upon which human judgment acts.

focal_logic_rules.name_zh: 图表叙事铁律：解读规律而非朗读表格（Interpret Patterns, Never Read Tables Aloud）
focal_logic_rules.core_principle_zh: 读者自己会看表格数字。实验段落的任务不是把 Table 1 的每一行数字抄进正文，而是回答三个问题：① 跨数据集的整体胜率与极值在哪？② 哪类基线在什么条件下崩盘了？③ 这种差异验证了我们在引言/方法中提出的什么假设？
focal_logic_rules.structural_formula: [Table Reference + Overall Dominance] -> [Contrast between Baseline Families under Hard Regime] -> [Mechanistic Explanation linking back to Method].
focal_logic_rules.common_pitfall_zh: 把表格每一行数字机械抄进正文，只报数不提炼规律与原因。
focal_logic_rules.bad_example_en: Table 1 shows the results. On dataset A, our model gets 91%. On dataset B, our model gets 88%. Our model is the best on all datasets.
focal_logic_rules.good_example_en: Table 1 shows that our model achieves the lowest forecasting error on 26 out of 30 benchmark settings. While point-wise Transformers degrade rapidly on volatile electricity load datasets (e.g., ECL), our multi-scale spectral mixer reduces MSE by an average of 16.4%, confirming that frequency-domain denoising stabilizes long-horizon representations.
focal_logic_rules.analysis_zh: 既有全局概览（26/30 最优），又有困难场景（波动剧烈的电力负载 ECL）下的流派对比，最后回扣方法论核心假设。

focal_logic_rules.category: Logical Fallacy Prevention (逻辑谬误防范)
focal_logic_rules.name_zh: 破除二元对立谬误：展现多维权衡（Transcending False Dichotomies）
focal_logic_rules.name_en: Moving Beyond False Dichotomies to Pareto Trade-offs
focal_logic_rules.core_principle_zh: 无论是讨论模型设计（精度 vs. 速度、生成多样性 vs. 保真度）还是社会议题（发展 AI vs. 保护就业、基础理论 vs. 工程应用），避免非黑即白的极端断言；用兼容性或帕累托改进框架（reconcile / bridge / balance X and Y by...）构建高阶论点。
focal_logic_rules.structural_formula: Rather than treating [Goal A] and [Goal B] as mutually exclusive, [Approach/Policy] reconciles both by [Mechanism C].
focal_logic_rules.common_pitfall_zh: 非此即彼，为了夸大一端而把另一端贬得一无是处。
focal_logic_rules.bad_example_en: Universities should stop teaching theoretical courses and only teach practical coding skills.
focal_logic_rules.good_example_en: Rather than treating mathematical foundations and engineering practice as mutually exclusive, computer science curricula can integrate both by embedding convex optimization and probability theory directly into hands-on machine learning studio projects.
focal_logic_rules.analysis_zh: 用 Rather than treating A and B as mutually exclusive, ... reconciles/integrates both by... 展现成熟严密的学术思辨。

seven_point_diagnosis_zh.1_controlling_idea: 原段中心论点被套话或碎片句淹没，首句未能直接立论。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.2_subject_length_and_balance: 存在【机械连接词膏药 + 旧新信息流断裂与逻辑跳跃（Mechanical Connectors & Logical Leap）】：主语冗长或句子结构松散，违反尾重原则（L011）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.3_given_to_new_flow: 句间缺乏旧信息向新信息的平滑过渡（违反 L015 图表叙事铁律：解读规律而非朗读表格（Interpret Patterns, Never Read Tables Aloud））。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.4_anaphora_and_connectors: 存在裸露的 This/It 指代或机械使用 First/Second/Moreover。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.5_colloquialism_and_ai_cliches: 缺乏生成模型核心术语（data manifold, velocity field, tangent projection, Euler integration），解释过于口语化。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.6_quantitative_or_instance_grounding: 缺乏 Metric-Baseline-Condition 三元组（L010）或具象行业微观案例（L021）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.7_voice_and_constituent_clarity: 谓语动词弱化为 be/make/get/have，未发挥强及物动词的骨架支撑作用。

step_by_step_surgery_zh: 第一步【砍壳提主干】：删去句首 AI 修辞帽与口语词，将核心实体（≤5词）提作全句主语。
第二步【强动词替换】：将 is very bad / makes it good 替换为精准及物动词（degrades / stabilizes / decouples / reduces）。
第三步【咬合信息流】：在第二、三句句首使用 `This/Such + 汇总名词` 承接上一句宾语，形成 Given-to-New 锁链。
第四步【注入实证锚点】：补全具体评测指标、对比基线或微观工程场景，彻底消除空洞夸张。

This projection guarantees exact boundary satisfaction at terminal time $\tau=1$ while maintaining straight transport paths amenable to 4-step Euler integration.

focal_revision_cases.domain_en: Academic Tech Talk & Conference Oral Delivery
focal_revision_cases.domain_zh: 顶会口头汇报（Tech Talk）与图表引导
focal_revision_cases.primary_defect_category: 机械连接词膏药 + 旧新信息流断裂与逻辑跳跃（Mechanical Connectors & Logical Leap）
focal_revision_cases.communicative_goal_zh: 我这一段想在问题分析类作文（Why is this happening?）中，剖析某个社会/科研痛点背后的深层原因（既指出直接表层诱因，又挖出底层的考核激励或结构性根源）。
focal_revision_cases.original_defective_paragraph: Why do many students copy AI answers directly? First, AI is very easy and fast to use. Second, students are lazy and have too much homework. So they just copy and paste.

seven_point_diagnosis_zh.1_controlling_idea: 原段中心论点被套话或碎片句淹没，首句未能直接立论。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.2_subject_length_and_balance: 存在【机械连接词膏药 + 旧新信息流断裂与逻辑跳跃（Mechanical Connectors & Logical Leap）】：主语冗长或句子结构松散，违反尾重原则（L011）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.3_given_to_new_flow: 句间缺乏旧信息向新信息的平滑过渡（违反 L005 去机械连接词化：用语义钩子替代 First/Second/Moreover）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.4_anaphora_and_connectors: 存在裸露的 This/It 指代或机械使用 First/Second/Moreover。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.5_colloquialism_and_ai_cliches: 把复杂社会教育现象简单归结为“学生懒（students are lazy）”，缺乏操作成本与评价体系两个层面的结构化深度。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.6_quantitative_or_instance_grounding: 缺乏 Metric-Baseline-Condition 三元组（L010）或具象行业微观案例（L021）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.7_voice_and_constituent_clarity: 谓语动词弱化为 be/make/get/have，未发挥强及物动词的骨架支撑作用。

step_by_step_surgery_zh: 第一步【砍壳提主干】：删去句首 AI 修辞帽与口语词，将核心实体（≤5词）提作全句主语。
第二步【强动词替换】：将 is very bad / makes it good 替换为精准及物动词（degrades / stabilizes / decouples / reduces）。
第三步【咬合信息流】：在第二、三句句首使用 `This/Such + 汇总名词` 承接上一句宾语，形成 Given-to-New 锁链。
第四步【注入实证锚点】：补全具体评测指标、对比基线或微观工程场景，彻底消除空洞夸张。
focal_revision_cases.revised_idiomatic_paragraph_en: The growing tendency among undergraduates to submit unverified AI-generated essays stems from both lowered friction costs and flawed assessment design. At an immediate level, conversational models produce grammatically polished drafts within seconds, tempting time-pressed students to bypass the arduous process of outlining and primary reading. More fundamentally, many university courses still rely on generic, formulaic essay prompts that reward surface fluency rather than original empirical critique. When effortless text generation meets standardized grading rubrics that fail to penalize hollow reasoning, superficial compliance inevitably crowds out deep inquiry.

focal_revision_cases.revised_idiomatic_paragraph_en: Instantiating closed-loop visuomotor diffusion on physical robots entails two technical challenges. First, because raw depth camera streams contain occlusion artifacts around reflective object edges, we introduce a tactile-guided cross-attention gate that reweights visual tokens upon contact onset. Second, to eliminate the 200 ms sampling bottleneck of iterative denoising, we formulate a trajectory consistency distillation objective that maps Gaussian noise directly to collision-free action chunks in two forward steps. Together, these designs sustain 50 Hz reactive control under partial visual occlusion.
